fato_historico: 1973: Watergate scandal: "Saturday Night Massacre": United States President Richard Nixon fires U.S. Attorney General Elliot Richardson and Deputy Attorney General William Ruckelshaus after they refuse to fire special prosecutor Archibald Cox, who is finally fired by Solicitor General Robert Bork.
energia_do_dia: Today may bring a shift in your perspective, urging you to stand firm in your values even when the winds of change blow strong. Much like those who chose integrity over convenience during historical storms, you are encouraged to honor your inner moral compass. It is a good time to trust your intuition and lead with absolute authenticity.
frase_do_dia: True power lies in the courage to remain honest when others falter.
significado_numero: A number representing spiritual wisdom and the discovery of hidden truths.
conselho: Stand your ground with grace and let your unique voice shine brightly today.
